notes.title: The sequel, "New Slippery Samurai," is now on sale!
notes.notes:
Nobunaga Oda, who was transported to the Heian period by Shingen Takeda and turned into a "lotion samurai" after a magical transformation, tries his best to return to his own time in "New Slippery Samurai," a down-to-earth time attack action game! The game has more gimmicks and bosses than the previous game, and offers a new level of fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1655920/

notes.title: The store page for the sequel, "New slippery Samurai," is now available.
notes.notes:
Nobunaga Oda, who was transported to the Heian period (794-1185) as a result of Shingen Takeda's trickery and turned into a "lotion samurai" after a magical transformation, is trying his best to return to his own time in "True Lotion Samurai," a downward-looking time attack action game. The gimmicks and bosses have changed since the last game. The game has more gimmicks and bosses than its predecessor, giving you a new way to play!

Look forward to its release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1655920/

notes.notes:

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.37 update
notes.notes:
In this update, we have fixed the problem.

Fixed an issue where time and lap time did not decrease when killing a golden ninja when the time and lap time were less than 1 second.

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.36 update
notes.notes:
In this update, we fixed a bug.

Fixed an issue where the key would not appear in the tutorial.

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.35 update
notes.notes:
How many times have you updated this thing?
We have made some system improvements in this update.

- We've eased a bug where the lap time function wasn't working properly.
　(It may not be completely fixed!)
Fixed an issue where NewRecord was always displayed.

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.34 update
notes.notes:
We have made improvements and additions to the system in this update.

In preparation for the big update, we have added an "Extra" section to the title screen.
　It's not available at the moment, but it will be available to play later.
Added description to the pause screen.
You can now turn on/off the lap time function from the options.
　With this, the lap time function cannot be turned on/off when clicking in the middle of the title screen anymore. The first time I saw it.

Known defects
It's best if you slay two golden ninjas on the way to the goal in 5-1 and 5-2 with a lap time of 1.99 or less. Bug that causes the lap time to be 00:02.00

We are currently investigating solutions to known problems.

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.33 update
notes.notes:
In this update, we have made some system additions.

It is now possible to perform a seppuku by selecting the seppuku command from the pause screen or using the F2 key.
　Performing a seppuku resets only the lap time and allows you to start over from the beginning of the floor.

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.32 update
notes.notes:
In this update, the system has been improved and added.

-The lap time function can be used by clicking the middle mouse button (mouse wheel) on the title screen. It is an experimental feature and may have bugs. We look forward to your feedback!
・The stage number is displayed thinly on the background of the ranking screen.

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.31 update
notes.notes:
In this update, we have increased the number of optional items.

・An item to adjust the hardness of the stick has been added to the options.

notes.title: Lotion samurai Ver1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Friend ranking implementation!
The population of the ranking has become larger than I expected, so subdivide!
In this update, the difficulty level has been adjusted and the system has been improved.

-Reduced the difficulty of Tier 2 of Stage 3.
　This adjustment does not affect the time.
・Shuriken Ninja will take longer to attack.
-Improved stability of ranking acquisition.
・The ranking has been subdivided.
-You can select the ranking from 1st to 10th, your surroundings, and your friends' rankings.

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.21 update
notes.notes:
This update improves the system and the stability of the game.

-Some processes have been made lighter.
-Improved stability of ranking acquisition.
・The ending is in Japanese, and the "RetsuEmpire" logo with the representative's face is now available.

notes.title: Lotion samurai Ver1.2 Update
notes.notes:
This game is too difficult.
This update only adjusts the difficulty level.

-Delayed the activation time of explosion and flame.
-Reduced the difficulty of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 4, Stage 5, and Stage 6.
　This correction does not affect the time.
-The evaluation criteria have dropped.

notes.title: Lotion Samurai ver1.11 update
notes.notes:
In this update, minor bugs are fixed and the system is improved.

-Changed to be able to switch between the rankings from 1st to 10th and those around you on the ranking screen.
-Changed to display "New Record!!" when the best time was recorded on the result screen after clearing the stage.
-Fixed the problem that volume adjustment of BGM and SE does not work well

notes.title: Lotion samurai ver1.1 update
notes.notes:
It's an update less than 24 hours after its release. It's a big behaviour.
In this update, the difficulty level has been adjusted and the system has been improved.

-Reduced the difficulty level of Stage 1, Stage 4, Stage 5, and Stage 6.
　This correction does not affect the time.
-The evaluation criteria have dropped.
・You can now retry with the F1 key.
-The window mode and full screen mode can now be selected from the options.
　At the first start-up, it will start up in full screen.
-The letters on the ranking screen are easier to see.
・Visualized the processing on the ranking screen. (It seems like you're saying something difficult, but don't worry about it)
